profiles.name: list_adb_devices
profiles.negative: Malformed ADB state output rejected with isError=true in original source MCP using a controlled private adb stub
profiles.scope: Original permanent REA Linux MCP owner-signed list_adb_devices {} returned adb 34.0.4-debian and zero attached devices. Isolated original REA MCP test exercised real AdbProvider parsing a source-owned malformed ADB device-state response, with isError=true. No physical device was contacted.
limits: Linux local ADB zero-device enumeration and malformed-state refusal only; USB/online/tcp devices and mutating device commands not certified.
Negative ran against isolated original source MCP and a stub adb executable, not a modified permanent service.

profiles.name: list_cutter_sessions
profiles.negative: Injected local Cutter bridge failure returned isError=true at original source MCP contract
profiles.scope: Original permanent REA Linux MCP owner-signed list_cutter_sessions {} returned no live Cutter sessions without sending commands. Source-owned isolated original MCP verified live synthetic Cutter bridge discovery, unsafe directory refusal and isError=true for injected bridge failure.
limits: Permanent REA host had no live GUI Cutter session; GUI session operations and external Cutter targets are not certified.
Negative error was injected in isolated original source MCP, not by changing the real Cutter provider.
Scope is permanent REA host signed positive plus isolated original-source MCP negative; not arbitrary real devices or sessions.
